newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down 16 cents on larger offering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down 16 cents on larger offering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down 16 cents at 14.11 ringgit ($5.70) a kg, pressured by a larger offering and lack of demand, traders said.
Traders noted initial offers for 127 tonnes against bids for 32 tonnes. "Buying from Europe and locally only appeared at the low levels," said one trader.
Final turnover was 102 tonnes, down from 186 on Tuesday.
Traders said they expect the price to hold above 14 ringgit, adding that fresh buying is likely as the local price is now at par with LME. It was at a $55 a tonne premium previously.
